entities.summary: Ariyike Lawal-Akinbobola, professionally known as Ariyike Akinbobola, is a Canada-based Nigerian author, television presenter, talk show host, model, blogger, trained lawyer and occasional Actor. Since 2011, she has worked as an associate producer and TV presenter for Spice TV a fashion and lifestyle channel on the DSTV platform. She hosted Spice TV's flagship programme 'On the Couch' and in addition she has produced and presented the fashion news and has as well presented other TV Shows including Sugar and Spice, Urban Spice, Instant Beauty Queen and Project Swan.
